default/32009.htm.text: Nurse Devorin: Doesn't he look handsome in this portrait? And he was just as handsome in the flesh. That is Frintezza, the last imperial prince of the Elmoreden empire. He was the son of Emperor Baium. We don't know where he is now, but...

Q00119_LastImperialPrince/32009-01.html.text: Nurse Devorin: You asked for a lullaby ? Who are you? There's only one person I ever sang a lullaby to...

Q00119_LastImperialPrince/32009-05.html.text: Nurse Devorin: Again, the words are: "Sleep now, child, a beautiful rose blossoms for you. Sleep now, child, till the morning comes to." Go tell him the words; help him.

Q00119_LastImperialPrince/32009-02.html.text: Nurse Devorin: What is this? Oh my, it's the prince's - no doubt about it! It may be old and worn, but there's no way my old eyes could ever forget this brooch . The prince must have sent you! Tell me, where is he now? Is he well?

Q00119_LastImperialPrince/32009-03.html.text: Nurse Devorin: What brooch did you say you were going to show me? I see no brooch. What are you playing at?

Q00119_LastImperialPrince/32009-04.html.text: Nurse Devorin: Ah. So the prince's past is coming back to haunt him, is it? Poor man! Poor child! I cannot offer much help, but I will do whatever I can for him. The words to the lullaby are: "Sleep now, child, a beautiful rose blossoms for you. Sleep now, child, till the morning comes to." My moth…
